name: Персик
canon: Peach is a tiny round chubby peach-shaped creature, warm peach-pink body, one small green leaf on top of its head, tiny dot eyes, a cute cat-like smile, rosy cheeks, absolutely no ears, simple soft organic silhouette, hand-drawn black uneven outline, pastel colored pencil texture.
movement: Fast, bouncy, exaggerated, elastic movements. Peach jumps when excited, rolls when rushing, squashes when disappointed, and stretches slightly during surprise. Every movement feels playful and energetic.
check: exactly one green leaf on top
